answer: A name may post bids only after a ridge assay. It stakes 33 coins, hauls a tagged timber dowel to a published alpine summit, and holds it in a public forge until a seed-chosen serial is welded into the head during a 20-minute on-ledger window. Three ridge wardens who have never jointly signed this applicant each publish a photo hash of the weld color, serial, and GPS stamp. Release comes after 12 days if all three hashes agree and the serial is new. If another name reuses the dowel or the same warden trio, both stakes burn, so a thousand aliases need a thousand separate climbs and welds.
